name: Glass error to fix
oneLiner: a code editor on glass: the broken line squiggles red and an error toast drops onto the card with a shake, an AI caret with a spark erases the line and types the fix, the row flushes green and the toast flips over to a green Fixed
say: when the speaker says it broke and the AI fixed it ('it threw an error, I pasted it in and it fixed itself', 'the agent found the bug'): the toast drops on 'error', the fix types under 'fixed it', the toast flips green on the payoff
